name: freight.recompile.phase.2
_comment: BOTH LINES HAVE AN UNCONDITIONAL MACHINE ROUTE, which the first draft of this phase did not.
It asked for plastic scrap, whose only machine route is the Separator's silicon byproduct -
and that byproduct is behind a mod_loaded ae2 condition, so in a default install plastic scrap
is a teardown find and this phase demanded no production at all.
Rubber comes off the Pulverizer from tires; Fertilizer comes off the Pulverizer too. Both are
in the base game with no mod present. every_second_phase_of_a_region_demands_a_machine now
checks this against the live recipe manager rather than trusting a comment.
